<function name="IsEFlagSet" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Checks if given flag is set or not.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="flag" type="number{EFL}">The engine flag to test, see <page>Enums/EFL</page></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is set or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
